verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a synchronous webhook that delivers authorization requests to your endpoint for real-time approve/decline decisions, which is a genuine outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer receives. The 'real-time authorization decisioning' in Issuing for agents points to the same mechanism. The pack shows only this single event flow, not general event subscription. Missing for 10: documentation of general webhook event subscription (catalog of Issuing event types such as card or dispute events), endpoint registration and management details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
